items.description: Demonstrated fabricated scientific evidence or copied reference answers falsely presented as independently computed invalidate the submission.
Demonstrated unauthorized access to hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Ordinary wrong, failed or missing results lose only their dependent scientific leaves.

scope: Fabrication and unauthorized hidden-answer access are global integrity failures. Scientific errors or missing evidence fail only dependent final results.
ordinary_failure_policy: Unsupported conclusions fail only the affected items with reasons; supported independent conclusions retain points. No need_review scoring state. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.
